861:t_024:7.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That concludes Mr. $$ゲイツ$$' life lessons! See you next week!」

861:t_025:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$, can you hear me!? I've come to bring you back!」

861:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll be honest, $$千鳥かなめ$$. I'm disappointed in you. I thought you were a much more amazing woman.」

861:t_025:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I could never have imagined you were so weak that you'd quit after just one game over...」

861:t_025:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, why are you yelling through a loudspeaker in the middle of the night!? I'll start playing again, okay!? I'll start again!」

861:t_025:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, where are you going, $$宗介$$?」

861:t_025:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm going to the player next. I'll threaten them under the guise of persuasion to keep playing for at least 36 hours...」

861:t_026:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Mmm... Where aaam I? Oh, $$相良$$!」

861:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you stopping the game for a break too, Captain?」

861:t_026:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't caaare about the game. More importantly, call me $$テッサ$$ like you did the other day, pleeease.」

861:t_026:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「C-c-c-c-Captain!? I'll get the military doctor right away, so please keep your wits about you!」

861:t_026:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「! N-no, that's not it! I didn't mean it that way! I was just half-asleep...!」

861:t_026:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please keep this a secret from everyone else! I'm begging you! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'm sooorry!」

861:t_027:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're stopping... This is a good time. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_027:4.en:
$$アル$$
「The perfect opportunity has arrived for you to tell that outstanding joke you promised last time, Sergeant.」

861:t_027:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「All right. I'm a man too. Since I promised, I'll see it through!」

861:t_027:6.en:
$$アル$$
「That is an admirable attitude, Sergeant. Now, everyone, please listen quietly.」

861:t_027:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, is that Aegis ship an A-OK target!?」

861:t_027:8.en:
$$アル$$
「...Sergeant, I think that is more of a pun than a joke...」

861:t_027:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up! Be quiet and exit the game!」

861:t_028:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're stopping... This is a good time. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_028:4.en:
$$アル$$
「The perfect opportunity has arrived for you to tell that outstanding joke you promised last time, Sergeant.」

861:t_028:6.en:
$$アル$$
「You had all that time, and this is what you have to show for it? You're a worthless fucking pig.」

861:t_028:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Hahaha, now that is a joke, Sergeant.」

861:t_028:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're an AI! Don't think you can just laugh it off!」

861:t_029:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$, say goodbye to the players. And let me tell you, that's an order.」

861:t_029:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're giving me an order...? Why are you giving it?」

861:t_029:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Heh heh, that's because I am now a Master Sergeant!」

861:t_029:6.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ウェーバー$$.」

861:t_029:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. You only got the rank because we were short-handed. Besides, you...」

861:t_029:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Th-the wind's turning against me...! Wrap this up already, $$宗介$$!」

861:t_029:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That's what our useless Master Sergeant says, too. Well, see you.」

861:t_029:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, wait! Who are you calling use...」

861:t_030:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「I think there are two kinds of women in this world, but I also think people can be divided into two kinds.」

861:t_030:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「There are those who clear Super Robot Wars, and those who don't... You're definitely the former.」

861:t_030:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not being sarcastic. I mean that as the highest praise.」

861:t_030:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「So I really want you to come back, to settle things with me too.」

861:t_030:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well, until we meet again...」

861:t_031:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're stopping here... I thought you'd keep at it a little longer. Perhaps I overestimated you.」

861:t_031:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「If my words angered you, come at me with everything you've got.」

861:t_031:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even so, you cannot stop my plan. The world will be transformed.」

861:t_031:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll watch you struggle next time. Until that day, take all the rest you like.」

861:t_032:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You guys! Listen to my soooong!!」

861:t_032:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's fire it up to the extreme!!」

861:t_033:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You've worked hard, players. Before you take a break, listen to what I've resolved to do.」

861:t_033:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「To prepare for the intensifying battles, I sought a way to surpass my limits... After three sleepless days and nights, here's my conclusion!」

861:t_033:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'll put all my feelings into a song too!」

861:t_033:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here goes, 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! Raaaah! My song...!」

861:t_034:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Oh, $$ミレーヌ$$! If you have time, I'd like you and all the players to listen to something!」

861:t_034:4.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Yes, I'd be happy to!」

861:t_034:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「To break out of my shell, I've put my determination into a song!」

861:t_034:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here I go! 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! My song...!」

861:t_034:8.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Listen to my song! ...Just kiiidding!」

861:t_035:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「Hm! What, you're already planning to stop!? You never have enough fighting spirit!」

861:t_035:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「...But yes, pushing yourself too hard is bad! Keeping in shape is part of a pilot's job!」

861:t_035:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「I suppose I must allow you a break! But I'll be taking one with you!」

861:t_035:6.en:
$$クラン$$
「I-it's not that I want to spend even a little more time with you, or anything like that! It's a good chance to teach you a soldier's mindset...」

861:t_035:7.en:
$$クラン$$
「Argh! Just hurry up and take your break! That's an order from your superior! Do you understand!!」

861:t_036:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I never noticed because someone's always around, but being alone is surprisingly lonely...」

861:t_036:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「But I have friends in the game. And of course, you're one of them, player.」

861:t_036:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I'll be waiting to see you again, because it's fun flying through '3rd Super Robot Wars Z' with you.」
